items.title: Core Orchestration Engine
items.description: Phase-based multi-agent workflow engine with tmux session management, verification gates, and conflict resolution.

items.title: Memory System
items.description: Three-layer memory: markdown memory bank, SQLite with FTS5, and vector search via chromem-go.

items.title: Plugin Architecture
items.description: Extensible plugin SDK supporting Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and custom tool integrations.

items.title: Web Dashboard
items.description: Real-time web UI for monitoring agent sessions, viewing logs, and managing workflows.

items.title: MCP Server Integration
items.description: First-class Model Context Protocol support for tool discovery and agent communication.

items.title: Cost & Token Tracking
items.description: Per-agent and per-session cost tracking with budget limits and usage analytics.

items.title: Enterprise Features
items.description: Team workspaces, RBAC, audit logs, and SSO integration for enterprise deployments.
